headline: Anthropic Shares Open at $111.50 as Co-Founders' Stakes Reach $180 Billion
summary: Anthropic shares began trading at an above-expectations price of $111.50 per share, lifting the collective paper fortunes of its seven co-founders to over $180 billion. The company maintains close ties with Nvidia.
why: Anthropic is a prominent generative artificial intelligence startup and developer of the Claude model family. Its public market valuation serves as a crucial benchmark for the economics of frontier AI development.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Anthropic shares began trading at $111.50 per share, above market expectations.
